## Download income and population data from INE

We download the income and population data from INE and save it into an .rds file.

```{r}
# Create the directory where the file will be stored:
dir.create("../data/ine", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Download income and population data from INE, and save them:
income_adrh_raw <- read.csv2("https://ine.es/jaxiT3/files/t/es/csv_bdsc/30824.csv?nocab=1")
saveRDS(income_adrh_raw, "../data/ine/income_adrh_raw.rds")

dem_adrh_raw <- read.csv2("https://ine.es/jaxiT3/files/t/es/csv_bdsc/30832.csv?nocab=1")
saveRDS(dem_adrh_raw, "../data/ine/dem_adrh_raw.rds")
```
